module_summary: Three-stage (E1, E2, WB) instruction pipeline controller: registers issued instruction info and control bits per stage, muxes ALU/CSR/div/mem/mul results, generates stall and exception-driven squash, and drives commit outputs.

anchors.name: issue_valid_i
anchors.why: Issued instruction valid; with accept loads E1 stage registers.

anchors.name: issue_accept_i
anchors.why: Issue accept qualifying entry of instruction into E1.

anchors.name: issue_stall_i
anchors.why: Global pipeline stall holding E1, E2 and WB registers and gating outputs.

anchors.name: valid_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 stage valid bit, advanced into valid_e2_q.

anchors.name: ctrl_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 decoded class bits (alu/load/store/csr/div/mul/branch/rd) steering result mux and outputs.

anchors.name: pc_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 stage PC register, output on pc_e1_o.

anchors.name: opcode_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 stage opcode register providing rd index.

anchors.name: operand_ra_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 stage operand A register.

anchors.name: exception_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 exception code incl. misaligned fetch, propagated to E2.

anchors.name: npc_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 next-PC from branch target or pc+4.

anchors.name: branch_misaligned_w
anchors.why: Taken branch target misaligned, raises fetch exception into E1.

anchors.name: valid_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 stage valid bit, cleared on squash or E1 exception.

anchors.name: ctrl_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 control bits selecting mem/mul bypass and stall on load/store.

anchors.name: result_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 result register selected from div, CSR or ALU result.

anchors.name: result_e2_r
anchors.why: E2 bypass result mux choosing mem or mul result over result_e2_q.

anchors.name: exception_e2_r
anchors.why: Final E2 exception code from memory or pipeline; triggers squash and WB.

anchors.name: exception_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 exception register: interrupt, E1 or CSR exception.

anchors.name: csr_wr_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 CSR write request carried to writeback.

anchors.name: valid_e2_w
anchors.why: E2 valid and not stalled; enables bypass selection and rd_e2_o.

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Stall when divide or load/store result not complete; gates rd outputs.

anchors.name: squash_e1_e2_o
anchors.why: Exception squash flushing E1 and E2 stages.

anchors.name: squash_e1_e2_q
anchors.why: Registered squash extending flush one cycle.

anchors.name: squash_e1_e2_i
anchors.why: External flush request clearing E1/E2 stages.

anchors.name: squash_wb_i
anchors.why: External flush request clearing WB stage.

anchors.name: valid_wb_q
anchors.why: WB stage valid, cleared on memory fault exceptions.

anchors.name: ctrl_wb_q
anchors.why: WB control bits, rd_valid cleared on exception.

anchors.name: result_wb_q
anchors.why: WB result register from mem, mul or E2 result.

anchors.name: opcode_wb_q
anchors.why: WB opcode providing rd index and CSR address.

anchors.name: valid_wb_o
anchors.why: Commit valid for retiring instruction.

anchors.name: result_wb_o
anchors.why: Writeback result data to register file.

anchors.name: rd_wb_o
anchors.why: Writeback destination register index, zeroed when not writing.

anchors.name: exception_wb_o
anchors.why: Committed exception code output.

anchors.name: csr_write_wb_o
anchors.why: CSR write enable at commit.

anchors.name: result_e2_o
anchors.why: E2 bypass result output for forwarding.

anchors.name: rd_e2_o
anchors.why: E2 destination register for forwarding/hazard detection.

anchors.name: rd_e1_o
anchors.why: E1 destination register for hazard detection.

anchors.name: alu_result_e1_i
anchors.why: ALU result captured into result_e2_q.

anchors.name: mem_result_e2_i
anchors.why: Load result bypassed into E2 and WB results.

anchors.name: mem_complete_i
anchors.why: Memory completion clearing load/store stall.

anchors.name: div_complete_i
anchors.why: Divider completion clearing divide stall.

groups.name: E1 stage
groups.description: Registers issued instruction, decoded class bits and early exception.

groups.name: E2 stage
groups.description: Result selection, mem/mul bypass and final exception resolution.

groups.name: Writeback stage
groups.description: Commit registers driving register-file and CSR writeback.

groups.name: Hazard and flush control
groups.description: Stall generation and exception-driven squash of pipeline stages.

groups.name: Commit interface
groups.description: Retired instruction results to regfile and CSR.

groups.name: Execution unit results
groups.description: Results from ALU, CSR, memory, multiplier and divider plus forwarding outputs.
